notes.title: Update 1.1.3.6
notes.notes: Small fix for a background that wasn't displayed properly. Please feel free to contact if you have any issues. Thank you.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36649223/d4f1f619cc9b7f54c45a886d9e931475b32f1c0c.jpg[/img]

I've been listening to your feedback about the game and prepared an update. I've modified a few things to improve the user experience. Here's the list of changes:

[u][b]Battle[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New buttons in battle: Meditate and Clear Path. Some of you had troubles to understand these mechanics, so they have been simplified.
[*] Reduced difficulty of almost all maps, especially Hospital.
[*] Added a hint button about how to skip dialogue during battle after restarting it at least once.
[*] Now, before battle, you'll have the chance to switch to novel mode. In the future I'll add this so it appears after losing a battle.
[*] I've changed some lines of dialogue during the tutorial to improve explanations.
[*] Fixed an issue where units with very low health would appear with their health bar empty.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies using Defense+ in Nexus map would not affect allies' stamina.
[*] Added the possibility of pushing enemies with keyboard or controller. Added buttons to guide the user through this process too.
[/list]

[u][b]Novel[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Optimized the way of obtaining hearts and fulfill character routes for new playthroughs after the first clear.
[*] Fixed an issue where keyboard or controller users on the castle's hall would be able to open several menus on top of each other.
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[*] Reduced the number of files loaded at the same time to avoid block issues.
[/list]

That's all. I hope you keep enjoying the game. If you have any issues, please, do not doubt to contact me. Thanks.

notes.title: 1.0.2 update
notes.notes:
I've updated the game to build 1.0.2. Restart Steam if it doesn't appear for you. You will be able to check your game version on the upper left corner of the main menu.

Fixes:

- Balanced all SFX in the game.
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to access "Gathering Memories" scene when it shouldn't.
- Reduced the files loaded when playing to avoid issues when skipping text.
- Fixed a few Spanish spelling mistakes.

notes.title: 1.0.1 update
notes.notes:
I've updated the game to build 1.0.1. Restart Steam if it doesn't appear for you. You will be able to check your game version on the upper left corner of the main menu.

Fixes:

- Fixed an issue where it was possible to block the game during the tutorial.
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to access Training and Study while reallocating slots during battle.
- Fixed an issue where some secondary events would persists after moments of the story where they shouldn't.
- Fixed a few Spanish spelling mistakes.

During the process of this fix, there was a build updated for a couple hours with incorrect lines of dialogue that would repeat during the entire game in Spanish. This was an error of uploading an incorrect build. Sorry for any troubles.

notes.title: Lotus Reverie: First Nexus Release Date
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=PA1TSZe-RFI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Lotus Reverie: First Nexus development is complete[/b]. We finished the game and it's playable from start to end.

Just as promised, the game will come out as soon as possible, but due to Steam Winter Sales, we are forced to release the game a bit later than expected. [b]Lotus Reverie: First Nexus will release on Steam the 14th of January of 2021.[/b]

If we were to release the game sooner, the game would be overshadowed by all the offers, which would affect the game visibility. I hope you can understand and wait just a few more weeks to enjoy the game.

From here up to the release date we'll share more information and I hope you all will join us in this adventure. Years of my life have been dedicated to this project, and if this game makes you at some point laugh or cry (in a good sense), I couldn't be any happier.

Thank you, and let's meet again.
I won't forget.
